person.name: Daniel (Dani) Idemudia
person.tagline: I like making stuff you can actually hold.
person.intro: Here's what I've designed, 3D printed and built. Each project shows the 3D file next to the real print, and you can download the files.

projects.title: The Beaver Dam NFC roundel
projects.summary: The NFC coin for Beaver Dam, an app I'm building that locks your apps until you tap it.

cover.alt: White 3D-printed round coin with a raised beaver face

story: Beaver Dam blocks your distracting apps. The only way to unlock them is to tap this coin with your phone, and there's an NFC tag sealed inside.
My first version used a cheap tag that kept missing taps. So I printed a bunch of versions, changing one thing at a time (size, wall thickness, how deep the tag sits) until it read every time.
highlights: 3 early concepts, then a 100 mm and a 70 mm version
The tag sits under a printed cap so it can't fall out

projects.title: Powertown Powerblock scale model
projects.summary: A desk-size model of Powertown's battery unit. The door opens and the batteries slide out.
story: Powertown puts batteries at local businesses and schools to cut their power bills. Most people have never seen one, so I made a model you can open up and hold.
It took four versions. I printed it in white first, then in black for presentations.

projects.title: "Dani the King" winged statue
projects.summary: A winged statue of me, about 20 cm tall.
story: I turned a photo of myself into a 3D model with Meshy, then added the wings, the fist and the base with my name on it.
The wings were the hardest part. They needed a lot of support, which you can see in the second photo before I cleaned it off.

projects.title: Anime birthday statue for Koko
projects.summary: A birthday gift for my friend Koko: the two of us as anime-style statues.
story: I made figures of me and Koko, then wrote a Python script that puts them on a base and adds the text.
There's a plain version and an anime version with a flame aura, swords and a big starburst behind us. I tried five sword poses before picking one, and did a small test print first.
highlights: Base, layout and text made with code

projects.title: Bike-shaped NFC tags
projects.summary: Bike-shaped keychains with an NFC tag in one wheel.
story: One wheel holds a round NFC sticker and the other has text on it. I went through a few versions before printing a batch.
This was my first time putting NFC in a print, before the Beaver Dam coin.

projects.title: Powertown desk figure kit
projects.summary: Nameplates for the Powertown team, with the logo on top.
story: Each person gets a navy base with their name and the Powertown logo pressed into the top.
I set it up so anyone on the team can make their own. You give Claude the template, ask it to change the name, and print it.

projects.title: PC builds
projects.summary: Computers I've built or upgraded myself.
story: White build: Ryzen 5 5600, ASRock B550 board, white Corsair case, an RTX Founders Edition card and a 1 TB NVMe drive.
Black build: NZXT case, ASUS TUF board, Sapphire Radeon card and purple RGB.
I also upgraded a Dell mini PC from a 240 GB SSD to 1 TB, and I've got a white ASUS RTX card ready for the next one.
highlights: Picked the parts and put them together myself

projects.title: Blackout curtain hook
projects.summary: A hook that holds my blackout curtains back when I'm not using them.
story: My roommate and I are both light sleepers, so we've got blackout curtains. I made this hook to hold them out of the way during the day.
The ring wraps around the curtain and the flat plate mounts to the wall.
